about.missionText: We believe manhwa deserves a dedicated space to celebrate its storytelling, art, and community. ManhwaVerse gives readers the tools to build their library, share their opinions, and discover new series through genuine community-driven scores.
about.contactText: Questions, suggestions, or partnerships? Reach us at

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Everything you need to know about ManhwaVerse.
faq.a1: ManhwaVerse is a community platform dedicated to manhwa (Korean webtoons and comics). You can track what you read, rate series, write reviews, follow other readers, and discover new titles.
faq.a2: Yes, ManhwaVerse is completely free. Create an account and start building your library right away.
faq.q3: How does the scoring system work?
faq.a3: Scores are calculated from community ratings combined with external data (AniList). The weight of each source adapts based on how many community votes a series has received.
faq.q4: Can I read manhwa on ManhwaVerse?
faq.a4: ManhwaVerse is a tracking and community platform — we do not host or stream chapters. Links to official reading platforms are provided on each series page.
faq.q5: How do I add a manhwa to my library?
faq.a5: Navigate to any series page and click the library button. You can set a reading status (Reading, Completed, Plan to read, etc.) and give it a score.
faq.a6: Korean reactions (헐, 대박, 감동…) are expressive one-tap reactions inspired by Korean internet culture that you can leave on any series.
faq.a7: The Reading Challenge lets you set a yearly goal for how many manhwa you want to complete. Your progress is tracked automatically based on titles you mark as completed.
faq.a8: Any registered user can create a curated list of manhwa — thematic recommendations, personal rankings, hidden gems, and more.
faq.q9: Can I report incorrect information about a series?
faq.a9: Yes. Use the report button on the series page or contact us directly at contact@manhwaverse.com and we will review it promptly.
faq.q10: How do I delete my account?
faq.a10: You can delete your account from your account settings page. All your data will be permanently removed within 30 days.
